slides.title: African Union steps up Ethiopia–Eritrea diplomacy
Peaceful dialogue. Protect civilians.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Capital Ethiopia, AU steps up diplomacy to ease Ethiopia-Eritrea tensions, Nov 4, 2026

card.title: AU urges Ethiopia and Eritrea to implement existing peace agreements
card.body: AU peace and security commissioner Bankole Adeoye says the AU is engaging leaders in both countries and does not take sides. Former Kenyan president Uhuru Kenyatta is leading shuttle diplomacy.
